verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents a different offload mechanism: MoE expert weights are streamed from SSD on demand, so peak memory tracks the active expert set. Nothing in the evidence describes splitting a model's layers or weights between CPU RAM and GPU VRAM, and the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot. SSD expert streaming is a related but different capability, so it earns no credit toward combined CPU+GPU offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
